title: Neanderthals go extinct
summary: Homo neanderthalensis disappears. Part of its DNA survives in people living outside Africa today.
why: The end of a close human relative that lived alongside our species in Eurasia.

notes.problem: 'Only surviving humans' is wrong: Denisovans 'ranged across Asia ... approximately 200,000-32,000 years ago', i.e. after 40,000.
